notes.title: V 1.3 More Controller Support! (Including Joy Cons!)
notes.notes: Added support of a lot more controllers, including nintendo switch joy cons!  Also threw in a lot of bug fixes for good measure!

notes.title: Price Drop!
notes.notes:
For a good handful of reasons, ranging from the changing landscape of indie game dev, our own personal goals with this game, and, of course, the response of YOU, the players: SuperLuminauts has taken a price cut!  We at LampFire believe this better fits the game we wanted to make and share with y'all.

For those of you that supported us before this, we at LampFire truly cannot properly thank you all enough.

Peace & Love

-Tom
